summary: Trees as objects for keel/lit: draws a tree-growth branch graph with surface roots, fluttering leaf blades, flowers and fruit that ripen and fall, litter, snow and one shared wind field, every part behind a feature switch. Also a background forest: baked variants instanced with GPU seasons, swapped for dithered impostor cards past a distance.

inputs.label: Parts
inputs.help: Feature switches as a plugin string, for example "-roots,-litter". Parts: roots, leaves, flowers, fruit, deadwood, litter, snow, fallers, sway, shadows, crownShade, bark.

inputs.label: Forest card distance
inputs.help: Past this distance from the camera, forest trees draw as impostor cards.
